purpose: Task-independent pre-training controllability family under explicitly authorized engineering assumptions; not quantitative biological calibration.

parent_context_model.status: Preserved unchanged; family runner reads topology/signs/role boundaries but applies policy values below.

contact_effect_mV_equivalent_per_contact.label: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION
contact_effect_mV_equivalent_per_contact.rationale: A predeclared broad model family spanning the earlier 0.01 and 0.05 mV-equivalent/contact reference scales, a geometric midpoint between 0.05 and 0.275, and 0.275 used as a global model scale in an adult Drosophila connectome SNN. None is claimed to be larval L2 physiology; the broad values are fixed without task or controllability outcomes.

tau_m_ms.label: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION
tau_m_ms.rationale: The endpoints include the existing 10 ms reference and a 20 ms Drosophila modeling prior; C is held at 1 nF and R is derived as tau/C. This is a model family, not cell-specific physiology.

threshold_mV_equivalent.label: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION
threshold_mV_equivalent.rationale: The lower endpoint preserves the earlier normalized 1 mV-equivalent threshold; 7 mV spans the resting-to-threshold difference used in published Drosophila connectome SNN parameterizations; 3 is the fixed interior grid point. Absolute voltages are not transferred as L2 measurements.

sensory_and_context_pulse_mV_equivalent.label: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION
sensory_and_context_pulse_mV_equivalent.rationale: A symmetric ± one-third family around the previously frozen 12 mV-equivalent, 5 ms pulse. KC and nociceptive-context channels share the same amplitude/duration in this family, so there is no independently tuned context gain.

tau_syn_ms.label: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION
tau_syn_ms.rationale: Held at the previously frozen reference and common Drosophila SNN convention; not treated as L2 measured physiology.

delay_ms.label: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION
delay_ms.rationale: Held at the previously frozen reference, close to 1.8 ms used in published Drosophila connectome SNNs; not L2 measured physiology.

tonic_background_mV_equivalent.label: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION
tonic_background_mV_equivalent.rationale: No tonic-drive measurement for this selected path is available; use zero to keep spontaneous activity/action an explicit neutral test rather than add an ungrounded context current.

action_threshold_goro_spikes.label: ENGINEERING OVERLAY
action_threshold_goro_spikes.rationale: Use the previously precommitted one-Goro-spike event as the primary fixed output; two spikes is an offline robustness check on the same recorded response, not another neural parameter or tuned decoder.

controllability_protocol.rule_direction: LTD-compatible controllability requires decreasing KC_to_MBON-d1 weights to increase or preserve Goro action-state sets as the MBON-d1 inhibitory gate is relieved.

robust_feasible_region_criterion.per_configuration: Zero-drive baseline has no action and finite state; all replays are deterministic and finite; under the primary 1-spike output, at least one lower KC-weight factor yields actions for 2-6 of 8 sensory states; action-state sets are nested as KC weights decrease; factor 1.0 is the no-learning reference.
robust_feasible_region_criterion.family: At least 12 of 72 configurations qualify; qualifying configurations span at least two values on each varied axis (contact effect, tau_m, threshold, pulse amplitude); largest face-connected component in the four-dimensional grid has at least 8 configurations.
robust_feasible_region_criterion.readout_robustness: At least 6 configurations in that same connected component retain a non-saturated 2-6 state action set at the offline 2-spike threshold with nested LTD-direction sets.
robust_feasible_region_criterion.selection_if_pass: Select the feasible configuration nearest the coordinate-wise median of the largest qualifying connected component; tie-break by lower contact scale, then lower pulse amplitude, then lexicographic parameter order. Do not use task performance, action accuracy, or eventual learning outcomes.
robust_feasible_region_criterion.if_fail: Reject L2 under this abstraction and stop before plasticity; preserve all failed and family results.

biological_scope: Signs/effect classes are inherited from the evidence ledger; all numeric family values remain engineering assumptions or overlays. A family PASS would establish robust simulator controllability only, not quantitative similarity to a living larva.
